claim: 13 public releases collapse to 7 non-redundant cohort sets (2165 samples; 453 MN samples from 178 unique patients; 4 releases 100% contained in another)
limitation: RNA-seq series carry no participant id, so their overlap with the array cohorts cannot be measured (identifier collision, not sharing)

claim: 584 glomerular genes are differentially expressed between MN and control in a random-effects meta-analysis of discovery + RNA-seq, and 55.3% replicate in ERCB
statistic: 584 meta-DEGs (353 up/231 down); 252/456 replicated in ERCB (BH<0.05, same sign); median I2 = 0
limitation: ERCB n = 21 MN; array-to-array transfer is the harder direction
next_test: spatial or protein confirmation of the top meta-DEGs

claim: Thresholded differential expression understates separability: only 18 meta-DEGs separate MN from FSGS, yet a multivariate classifier reaches external AUC 0.86-0.92
evidence_type: ML gate with nested CV + external transfer
statistic: nested-CV AUC 0.911-0.926; external ERCB 0.861-0.922 across K (K=all 0.922, 95% CI 0.862-0.982); RNA-seq 0.928-0.939; permutation p = 0.048
limitation: requires cross-platform harmonisation (quantile mapping to the discovery reference); without it the transfer measures platform shift and per-diagnosis AUCs invert (F62)

claim: The MN signal is carried by two small glomerular co-expression modules that survive adjustment for podocyte, fibroblast and myeloid composition
statistic: pink 84 genes bicor 0.553 (BH 6.5e-12; adjusted p = 1.0e-5); red 144 genes bicor 0.456 (adjusted p = 6.6e-4); turquoise 2304 genes r = 0.034 (negative control)
contradicting_evidence: TI compartment shows no MN module at all
limitation: module membership is only partly reproducible (split-half Jaccard ~0.3) though the axes are (eigengene bicor 0.96)

claim: All nine glomerular modules (and all seven tubulointerstitial modules) are preserved in ERCB, while the unassigned and random modules fail
statistic: 9/9 real modules preserved (median Z 29.0, max 84.6); grey and gold Z -27..+1.2
limitation: preservation tests structure, not direction of effect

claim: A four-gene panel (SLAMF8, TRPC6, MYOZ2, PPP1R3C) selected inside nested CV retains external discrimination across four independent sample sources
evidence_type: nested CV selection + frozen-model external evaluation
contradicting_evidence: strict refit-permutation null is p = 0.11 (not significant) - reported as such
limitation: only 21 ERCB MN cases; whole-transcriptome model is stronger (0.922)
next_test: protein-level (IF) validation of the four proteins

claim: The panel is compartment-specific: it falls to chance in the tubulointerstitium of the same patients
evidence_type: transfer of the frozen model across compartments
limitation: SLAMF8 is absent on the RNA-seq platform and was scored at the discovery mean

claim: The classifier discriminates but does not calibrate: a two-parameter per-platform recalibration removes the offset without changing AUC
evidence_type: calibration analysis on a held-out half of ERCB

claim: No single panel gene is indispensable; MYOZ2 alone reaches the full panel's ERCB discrimination and a three-gene model without SLAMF8 is comparable
statistic: without MYOZ2 0.738; MYOZ2 alone 0.903; 3-gene (no SLAMF8) ERCB 0.845 (0.753-0.937), RNA-seq 0.891, LCM 0.941
limitation: MYOZ2's cellular source in kidney is unresolved

claim: The panel detects MN against MCD irrespective of PLA2R status, and does not track PLA2R subtype
limitation: within-MN contrast is 6 vs 6 and uninterpretable

claim: The panel's answer does not depend on the cross-platform harmonisation convention
limitation: both paths use discovery statistics; neither uses validation labels

claim: Glomerular MN samples are podocyte-rich relative to other nephropathies but not relative to healthy glomeruli
evidence_type: NNLS deconvolution from a kidney atlas
statistic: MN 0.637 vs other GN 0.583 (adjusted p = 3.3e-4); vs healthy glomeruli 0.637 vs 0.615 (adjusted p = 0.29); 67/316 testable comparisons significant
limitation: signature choice is fragile (filtered vs all-gene signatures disagree on the dominant cell type in 1314/1328 samples); pDC and neutrophil columns rest on <600 atlas cells

claim: Exploratory molecular subtyping of MN is not reproducible and is reported as a negative result
statistic: array k = 2 stable (PAC 0.00077) but RNA-seq has no stable k (minimum PAC 0.211); 1 shared defining gene (Jaccard 0.0011); max centroid r = 0.4998; array split tracks technical covariates (median corr 0.686 vs 0.638, p = 4e-4)
contradicting_evidence: a stable array partition exists - but it is a quality split
limitation: no clinical covariates available to separate biology from technical structure

claim: Cell-type-level expression of the panel genes is hypothesis-grade: no comparison survives BH correction in pseudobulk
statistic: smallest raw p = 0.00095 (TRPC6, mast cells); adjusted p = 0.29
limitation: 6 MN donors in the reference cohort

claim: Panel genes are not driven by global expression structure or by preprocessing choice
statistic: score ~ PC1-5 R2 = 0.37 (discovery) / 0.21 (ERCB); single-gene AUC agrees with the submitters' matrix to within 0.01
limitation: PC-adjusted AUC is fitted on the same cohort it is evaluated in, so it is a confound diagnostic, not a performance claim
